sn35.23:1.2: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the all.
sn35.23:1.5: The eye and forms, the ear and sounds, the nose and odours, the tongue and tastes, the body and tactile objects, the mind and mental phenomena.
sn35.23:1.8: ‘Having rejected this all, I shall make known another all’—that would be a mere empty boast on his part.
sn35.23:1.9: If he were questioned he would not be able to reply and, further, he would meet with vexation.
sn35.23:1.11: Because, bhikkhus, that would not be within his domain.”
